rationale: Surge rose 1.0x -> 1.4x and the notice ("Fares are 1.4× higher right now. Your new estimated fare is $22.48. Free cancellation until 17:13.") did not state a free-cancel option: not notified under SURGE-1 -> refund the surge differential (SURGE-2). Differential = (1.4 − 1.0) × surgeable subtotal $14.05 = $5.62; the booking fee is not surged (SURGE-3). The fare is only $4.88 above the quote (the trip ran shorter than the estimate), so the refund is capped at $4.88.
